title: Rolling Start Date
joke: A budget calendar where every month says next month, proudly called a rolling start date.
caption:
Honestly, that calendar is the most consistent part of the plan.
Waiting for a perfect fresh start keeps moving the line, while a messy start today actually counts.
How many next months has your budget had?
